```{r}
#Risk estimates
#Source: A Quantitative Risk Assessment of Human Salmonellosis from Consumption of Pistachios in the United States
#SOFIA M. SANTILLANA FARAKOS

#Pistachio risk per serving for 4 and 5 log reductions

#Sinker medians
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_4_log_treat <- 3.63*10^-12
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_5_log_treat <- 3.63*10^-13
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_0_log_treat <- 3.43*10^-8
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_sinker_4_log_treat <- 2.26*10^-18
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_sinker_5_log_treat <- 2.26*10^-19
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_sinker_0_log_treat <- 2.14*10^-14

#Floater medians  
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_4_log_treat <- 9.49*10^-12
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_5_log_treat <- 9.49*10^-13
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_0_log_treat <- 9.07*10^-08
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_floater_4_log_treat <- 5.95*10^-18
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_floater_5_log_treat <- 5.95*10^-19
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_floater_0_log_treat <- 5.73*10^-14

#Sinker means
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_4_log_treat_mean <- 4.94*10^-11
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_5_log_treat_mean <- 4.86*10^-12
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_0_log_treat_mean <- 4.88*10^-7
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_sinker_4_log_treat_mean <- 3.07*10^-17
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_sinker_5_log_treat_mean <- 3.04*10^-18
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_sinker_0_log_treat_mean <- 3.05*10^-13

#Floater means  
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_4_log_treat_mean <- 6.23*10^-10
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_5_log_treat_mean <- 6.23*10^-11
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_0_log_treat_mean <- 6.24*10^-6
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_floater_4_log_treat_mean <- 3.96*10^-16
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_floater_5_log_treat_mean <- 3.94*10^-17
risk_per_serve_core_ingredient_cooked_floater_0_log_treat_mean <- 4.03*10^-12

#serving sizes
serving_size_g_core_product_not_cooked <- 35.6 #g pistachios, use core product
serving_size_g_ingredient_cooked <- 3.1 #g pistachios

#proportion each type
proportion_sinker <- 0.85
proportion_floater <- 0.15

#calculate combined risk, medians
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_0_log <- (proportion_sinker*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_0_log_treat) + (proportion_floater*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_0_log_treat)

risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_4_log <- (proportion_sinker*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_4_log_treat) + (proportion_floater*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_4_log_treat)

risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_5_log <- (proportion_sinker*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_5_log_treat) + (proportion_floater*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_5_log_treat)

#calculate combined risk, means
risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_0_log_mean <- (proportion_sinker*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_0_log_treat_mean) + (proportion_floater*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_0_log_treat_mean)

risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_4_log_mean <- (proportion_sinker*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_4_log_treat_mean) + (proportion_floater*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_4_log_treat_mean)

risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_5_log_mean <- (proportion_sinker*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_sinker_5_log_treat_mean) + (proportion_floater*risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_floater_5_log_treat_mean)
```

```{r}
#recall size
sales_original <- 40000000*0.453592  #kg per year
sales_original_other <- 40000000*0.453592  #kg per year
recall_size_rate <- 0.325
recall_size_kg <- recall_size_rate*sales_original #kg of pistachios recalled, same as almonds
recall_size_g <- recall_size_kg*1000

servings_core_product_uncooked <- 3.7*10^8
servings_ingredient_cooked <- 6.4*10^7
total_servings_us <- servings_core_product_uncooked + servings_ingredient_cooked
proportion_servings_core_product_uncooked <- servings_core_product_uncooked/total_servings_us
proportion_servings_ingredient_cooked <- servings_ingredient_cooked/total_servings_us


```

```{r}
#cost estimate
number_years <- 1 #years, set to 1 because NPV calculation calculates cash flow each year

#create initial for loop
cost_capital_tech <- 5000000 #dollars #cost of heat treatment tech, if RTE system. In NPV formula, this is C0

cost_sanitation_tech <- 20000*number_years #dollars
cost_utilities_tech <- 10000*number_years #dollars
cost_consumables_tech <- 100000*number_years #dollars
cost_operating_tech <- cost_sanitation_tech + cost_utilities_tech + cost_consumables_tech #total cost operating tech, dollars

#calculating lost product - using unit value (assuming that this is what the farm would get paid for the almonds)
amt_product_recalled <-  recall_size_kg  #kg
unit_value <- 6.58/0.453592  #dollars per kg, unit values US shelled almonds exports
price_original <- unit_value
cost_lost_product <- amt_product_recalled*price_original #dollars

#calculate restocking fees
destroy_fee <- (50/1323)/0.453592  #dollars per kg
restock_factor <- 0.5 #portion of product recalled that is on shelves and must be restocked
amt_product_restock <- recall_size_kg*restock_factor #kg, assume all product
restocking_fee <- 300 #dollars, flat rate per store
number_stores <- 5000 #stores where product is sold (estimation)
cost_restocking1 <- destroy_fee*amt_product_restock + restocking_fee*number_stores  #dollars
spillover_rate <- 0.075 #portion of product, compared to recalled product, that is not affected by the recall but still restocked
cost_restocking <- cost_restocking1 + spillover_rate*cost_restocking1 #account for spillover 
holding_fee <- 1.5/0.453592 #dollars per kg
holding_rate <- 0.05 #portion of product, compared to recalled product, that is not affected by the recall but is held in a storage facility
cost_holding_product <- holding_fee*(holding_rate*amt_product_restock) #dollars, batch that is a portion of the restocked amount is not recalled, but must be held somewhere.
cost_restocking <- cost_restocking + cost_holding_product #include holding costs with restocking

#cost litigation
cost_litigation <- 5000000 #dollars, assume large recall

#cost crisis management
cost_crisis_management <- 15000 #dollars

#cost enhanced product testing
number_years_ept <- 1 #years
cost_consumables_ept <- 10000*number_years_ept #dollars
cost_utilities_ept <- 10000*number_years_ept #dollars
cost_ept <- 0 #cost is negligible.



#calculate change in demand for product

sale_decrease_after_recall <- 0.175 #% decrease (e.g., 0.2 = 20%) 
sale_decreased_period <- 20/365 #years
sales_after_recall <- (1 - sale_decrease_after_recall)*sales_original #kg/year
price_decrease <- 0 
price_new <- (1 - price_decrease)*price_original
cost_demandchange_product <- sales_original*price_new*sale_decrease_after_recall*sale_decreased_period #dollars, loss of sales/value due to demand change.


#calculate change in demand for related/other products 

price_original_other <- unit_value #dollars per kg
sale_decrease_after_recall_other <- 0.1 #% decrease (e.g., 0.2 = 20%)
sale_decreased_period_other <- 20/365 #years
sales_after_recall_other <- (1 - sale_decrease_after_recall_other)*sales_original_other #kg/year
price_decrease_other <- 0 
price_new_other <- (1 - price_decrease_other)*price_original_other #dollars per kg
cost_demandchange_otherproduct <- sales_original_other*price_new_other*sale_decrease_after_recall_other*sale_decreased_period_other #dollars


#calculate cost temporary lost production
plantdowntime <- 7/365 #years
production_rate_downtime <- sales_original #kg/year
cost_temp_lost_production <- plantdowntime*production_rate_downtime*price_original #dollars


#traceability1 cost
cost_traceability1_capital <- 0 #dollars
cost_traceability1_utilities <- 0*number_years #dollars
cost_traceability1 <- 0 #Cost assumed to be negligible 


#costs recall insurance (and cost negations)
prevalence_recallins <- 0 #either 0 or 1
cost_recallins_premium <- 600000 #dollars per year
cost_recallins_premium <- prevalence_recallins*cost_recallins_premium*number_years
recallins_coverage <- 10000000 #dollars
benefits_recallins <- ifelse(prevalence_recallins == 0, 0, recallins_coverage)

#cost recall only - use for outbreak traced to company, does not include capital tech/operating 
recallcost <- cost_lost_product + cost_restocking + cost_litigation + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product + cost_demandchange_otherproduct + cost_temp_lost_production + cost_recallins_premium  - benefits_recallins #traceability not included bc negligible
recallcost <- ifelse(recall_size_kg == 0, 0, recallcost) #if no recall, no cost


#cost recall NO ILLNESSES
noillness_recall_factor <- 0.8 #assume there is some factor that decreases these costs when no illnesses are involved
recallcost_noillnesses <- noillness_recall_factor*( cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product + cost_demandchange_otherproduct) + cost_recallins_premium + cost_lost_product + cost_restocking +  cost_temp_lost_production  - benefits_recallins #traceability not included nc negligible
recallcost_noillnesses <- ifelse(recall_size_kg == 0, 0, recallcost_noillnesses)


#sum total cost
totalcost1 <- cost_capital_tech + cost_operating_tech + cost_lost_product + cost_restocking + cost_litigation + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product + cost_demandchange_otherproduct + cost_temp_lost_production + cost_traceability1 + cost_recallins_premium - benefits_recallins


#cost of tech only
foodsafetytech_cost <- cost_capital_tech + cost_operating_tech


#costs for no recall, other interventions

#enhanced product testing
cost_consumables_ept_norecall <- 5000 #dollars
cost_utilities_ept_norecall <- 5000 #dollars
cost_ept_norecall <- 0 #negligible

#downtime (assume for sanitation)
plantdowntime_norecall <- 7/365 #years
production_rate_downtime_norecall <-  sales_original #kg otherwise produced during duration of downtown
cost_temp_lost_production_norecall <- plantdowntime_norecall*production_rate_downtime_norecall*price_original #dollar

#include costs for increased sanitation
cost_consumables_sani_norecall <- 20000 #dollars, cost sanitation consumables
cost_sani_utilities_norecall <- 10000 #dollars, utilities used during sanitation
cost_labor_sani_norecall <- 10000 #dollars


cost_sani_norecall <- cost_consumables_sani_norecall + cost_sani_utilities_norecall + cost_labor_sani_norecall #dollars
cost_norecall_otherint <- cost_ept_norecall + cost_temp_lost_production_norecall +cost_sani_norecall

```



```{r}
#Calculating EVs

recall_servings_core_product_not_cooked <- recall_size_g/serving_size_g_core_product_not_cooked # servings core product not cooked involved in recall

p_outbreaktraced_trace1 <- 0.91
p_outbreaktraced_trace2 <- 0.95


#calculate EV outbreak traced to company
EV_traceability1 <- p_outbreaktraced_trace1*(recallcost + cost_traceability1) + (1 - p_outbreaktraced_trace1)*cost_traceability1 # dollars, expected value of node where outbreak is traced to company or not

p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_0log <- 1/38.9 #from scallan - salmonella case underestimation
p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_4log <- 1/38.9 #from scallan - salmonella case underestimation
p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_5log <- 1/38.9 #from scallan - salmonella case underestimation


#Ev illness linked to outbreak
EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_0log*(EV_traceability1) 
EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_4log*(EV_traceability1) 
EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_5log*(EV_traceability1) 


#Ev illness not linked to outbreak
EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log <- (1 - p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_0log)*0 #no costs for no outbreak at this step
EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log <- (1 - p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_4log)*0 #no costs for no outbreak at this step
EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log <- (1 - p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_5log)*0 #no costs for no outbreak at this step


```


```{r}
#convert sales original (kg)
servings_per_kg_core_product <- (1/serving_size_g_core_product_not_cooked)*1000   #Servings per kg

#compound annual risk for 0 log - use same approach for the 3 different types of almonds

annualrisk_0log_median <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_0_log)^(sales_original*servings_per_kg_core_product)
annualrisk_0log_median <- ifelse(annualrisk_0log_median > 1, 1, annualrisk_0log_median)

annualrisk_0log_median_sanitize <- 10^(log10(annualrisk_0log_median) -1) #annual risk if no recall, but other intervention (sanitization), assumed 1 log reduction in annual risk

annualrisk_4log_median <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_4_log)^(sales_original*servings_per_kg_core_product)
annualrisk_4log_median <- ifelse(annualrisk_4log_median > 1, 1, annualrisk_4log_median)

annualrisk_4log_median_sanitize <- 10^(log10(annualrisk_4log_median) -1) #annual risk if no recall, but other intervention (sanitization), assumed 1 log reduction in annual risk

annualrisk_5log_median <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_5_log)^(sales_original*servings_per_kg_core_product)
annualrisk_5log_median <- ifelse(annualrisk_5log_median > 1, 1, annualrisk_5log_median)

annualrisk_5log_median_sanitize <- 10^(log10(annualrisk_5log_median) -1) #annual risk if no recall, but other intervention (sanitization), assumed 1 log reduction in annual risk


#EV illness

EV_illness_0log_median <- (annualrisk_0log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_4log_median <- (annualrisk_4log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_5log_median <- (annualrisk_5log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)

#EV no illness
EV_noillness_0log_median <- (1 - (annualrisk_0log_median))*0 #no costs for no illnesses

EV_noillness_4log_median <- (1 - (annualrisk_4log_median))*0 #no costs for no illnesses

EV_noillness_5log_median <- (1 - (annualrisk_5log_median))*0 #no costs for no illnesses


#calculate p(contamination detected during testing)
detectionlimit <- 0.1 #log cfu/g  NOTE: example value

p_contamination_bags_0log_sinker <- 6.6*10^-4
p_contamination_bags_4log_sinker <- 7*10^-8
p_contamination_bags_5log_sinker <- 6.9*10^-9

p_contamination_bags_0log_floater <- 5.6*10^-3
p_contamination_bags_4log_floater <- 8.8*10^-7
p_contamination_bags_5log_floater <- 8.9*10^-8

detectable_contam_rate_0log <- (0.85*p_contamination_bags_0log_sinker) + (0.15*p_contamination_bags_0log_floater) #proportion of samples with contamination detectable by testing, partition into packages
detectable_contam_rate_4log <- (0.85*p_contamination_bags_4log_sinker) + (0.15*p_contamination_bags_4log_floater) #proportion of samples with contamination detectable by testing, partition into packages
detectable_contam_rate_5log <- (0.85*p_contamination_bags_5log_sinker) + (0.15*p_contamination_bags_5log_floater) #proportion of samples with contamination detectable by testing, partition into packages



sample_weight <- 25 #g
number_samples_day <- 5
number_samples_year <- number_samples_day*365
conc_contam_unit_4log <- 1 #cfu
conc_contam_unit_5log <-1 #cfu
unit_size_fda <- 224 #g
conc_contam_4log <- conc_contam_unit_4log/unit_size_fda #cfu/g
conc_contam_5log <- conc_contam_unit_5log/unit_size_fda #cfu/g

#NOTE that previous line of code assumes sampling rate is equivalent to 25/10,000 bags
p_test_contam_0log <- 0 #Assume untreated products are not tested

p_test_contam_4log_sample <- detectable_contam_rate_4log*(1 - exp(-conc_contam_4log*sample_weight)) #localized low level contam 
  
p_test_contam_4log <- 1 - (1 - p_test_contam_4log_sample)^number_samples_year #compound probability for a year

p_test_contam_5log_sample <- detectable_contam_rate_5log*(1 - exp(-conc_contam_5log*sample_weight)) #localized low level contamiation, poisson process 

p_test_contam_5log <- 1 - (1 - p_test_contam_5log_sample)^number_samples_year #compound probability for a year


#EV contam not detected
EV_contam_notdetected_0log_median <- (1 - p_test_contam_0log)*(EV_illness_0log_median + EV_noillness_0log_median)

EV_contam_notdetected_4log_median <- (1 - p_test_contam_4log)*(EV_illness_4log_median + EV_noillness_4log_median)

EV_contam_notdetected_5log_median <- (1 - p_test_contam_5log)*(EV_illness_5log_median + EV_noillness_5log_median)

#EV recall, no illness
EV_recall_noillness <- recallcost_noillnesses #dollars


#Possibility of illness for no recall intervention

p_illness_norecall_0log_median <- number_years*annualrisk_0log_median_sanitize 
p_illness_norecall_4log_median <- number_years*annualrisk_4log_median_sanitize
p_illness_norecall_5log_median <- number_years*annualrisk_5log_median_sanitize


#EV illness, no recall
EV_illness_norecall_0log_median <- p_illness_norecall_0log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_norecall_4log_median <- p_illness_norecall_4log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_norecall_5log_median <- p_illness_norecall_5log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#EV no illness, no recall
EV_noillness_norecall_0log_median <- (1- p_illness_norecall_0log_median)*0
EV_noillness_norecall_4log_median <- (1- p_illness_norecall_4log_median)*0
EV_noillness_norecall_5log_median <- (1- p_illness_norecall_5log_median)*0


#EV no recall
EV_norecall_0log_median <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_0log_median + EV_noillness_0log_median

EV_norecall_4log_median <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_4log_median + EV_noillness_4log_median

EV_norecall_5log_median <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_5log_median + EV_noillness_5log_median


#creating vector for contamination detected/not detected
contam_detect_test_0log_median <- c(median(EV_recall_noillness), median(EV_norecall_0log_median)) #combine into vector so can compare, this is the EV of contam detected during test

contam_detect_test_4log_median <- c(median(EV_recall_noillness), median(EV_norecall_4log_median)) #combine into vector so can compare, this is the EV of contam detected during test

contam_detect_test_5log_median <- c(median(EV_recall_noillness), median(EV_norecall_5log_median)) #combine into vector so can compare, this is the EV of contam detected during test


#EV contam detect test
EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median <- p_test_contam_0log*(min(contam_detect_test_0log_median)) #dollars, forces min as decision would favor min EV at this decision node
EV_contam_detect_test_4log_median <- p_test_contam_4log*(min(contam_detect_test_4log_median)) #dollars, forces min as decision would favor min EV at this decision node
EV_contam_detect_test_5log_median <- p_test_contam_5log*(min(contam_detect_test_5log_median)) #dollars, forces min as decision would favor min EV at this decision node


#EV food safety tech
extra_reduction_cost_factor <- c(1, 1.05, 1.1, 1.15, 1.2, 1.25)

#NOTE: THESE EQUATIONS NOT USED IN LATER CASH FLOW CALCS. THEY EXIST TO COMPARE EV OUTSIDE OF NPV.
EV_0log_median <- foodsafetytech_cost + cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_0log_median + EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median #dollars
EV_4log_median <- foodsafetytech_cost + cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_4log_median + EV_contam_detect_test_4log_median #dollars
EV_5log_median <- foodsafetytech_cost + cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_5log_median + EV_contam_detect_test_5log_median #dollars

#convert to cash flows
#0 log
cashflow_0log_median1 <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_0log_median + EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median #dollars
#set up cash flow vector for desired analysis length
analysis_length <- 20 #years
cashflow_0log_median <- rep(0, each = analysis_length)
cashflow_0log_median[1] <- cashflow_0log_median1   # Initial investment cost at time 0

#Calculate annual cash flow - for loop
for (t in 2:length(cashflow_0log_median)){
  #check if it's a year that has a training cost
  if (t %% 4 == 0){
    cost_training_tech <- 0 #dollars
  } else {
    cost_training_tech <- 0 #dollars
  }
  cashflow_0log_median[t] <- cost_training_tech + cashflow_0log_median1 #Add costs
}



#4 log
cashflow_4log_median1 <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_4log_median + EV_contam_detect_test_4log_median #dollars
#set up cash flow vector for desired analysis length
analysis_length <- 20 #years
cashflow_4log_median <- rep(0, each = analysis_length)
cashflow_4log_median[1] <- cost_capital_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[4] + cost_training_tech + cost_operating_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[4] + cashflow_4log_median1   # Initial investment cost at time 0

#Calculate annual cash flow - for loop
for (t in 2:length(cashflow_4log_median)){
  #check if it's a year that has a training cost
  if (t %% 4 == 0){
    cost_training_tech <- 20000 #dollars
  } else {
    cost_training_tech <- 0 #dollars
  }
  cashflow_4log_median[t] <- cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[4]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_4log_median1 #ADD ALL THE COSTS
}


#5 log
cashflow_5log_median1 <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_5log_median + EV_contam_detect_test_5log_median #dollars
#set up cash flow vector for desired analysis length
analysis_length <- 20 #years
cashflow_5log_median <- rep(0, each = analysis_length)
cashflow_5log_median[1] <- cost_capital_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[5] + cost_training_tech + cost_operating_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[5] + cashflow_5log_median1   # Initial investment cost at time 0

#Calculate annual cash flow - for loop
for (t in 2:length(cashflow_5log_median)){
  #check if it's a year that has a training cost
  if (t %% 4 == 0){
    cost_training_tech <- 20000 #dollars
  } else {
    cost_training_tech <- 0 #dollars
  }
  cashflow_5log_median[t] <- cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[5]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_5log_median1 #ADD ALL THE COSTS
}


```


```{r}
#repeat for means 

annualrisk_0log_mean <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_0_log_mean)^(sales_original*servings_per_kg_core_product)
annualrisk_0log_mean <- ifelse(annualrisk_0log_mean > 1, 1, annualrisk_0log_mean)

annualrisk_4log_mean <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_4_log_mean)^(sales_original*servings_per_kg_core_product)
annualrisk_4log_mean <- ifelse(annualrisk_4log_mean > 1, 1, annualrisk_4log_mean)

annualrisk_5log_mean <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_5_log_mean)^(sales_original*servings_per_kg_core_product)
annualrisk_5log_mean <- ifelse(annualrisk_5log_mean > 1, 1, annualrisk_5log_mean)


#EV illness
EV_illness_0log_mean <- (number_years*annualrisk_0log_mean)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_4log_mean <- (number_years*annualrisk_4log_mean)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_5log_mean <- (number_years*annualrisk_5log_mean)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#EV no illness
EV_noillness_0log_mean <- (1 - (number_years*annualrisk_0log_mean))*0 #no costs for no illnesses
EV_noillness_4log_mean <- (1 - (number_years*annualrisk_4log_mean))*0 #no costs for no illnesses
EV_noillness_5log_mean <- (1 - (number_years*annualrisk_5log_mean))*0 #no costs for no illnesses


#ev contam not detected
EV_contam_notdetected_0log_mean <- (1 - p_test_contam_0log)*(EV_illness_0log_mean + EV_noillness_0log_mean)
EV_contam_notdetected_4log_mean <- (1 - p_test_contam_4log)*(EV_illness_4log_mean + EV_noillness_4log_mean)
EV_contam_notdetected_5log_mean <- (1 - p_test_contam_5log)*(EV_illness_5log_mean + EV_noillness_5log_mean)

#add in possibility of illness for no recall intervention
p_illness_norecall_0log_mean <- number_years*annualrisk_0log_mean
p_illness_norecall_4log_mean <- number_years*annualrisk_4log_mean 
p_illness_norecall_5log_mean <- number_years*annualrisk_5log_mean 


#EV illness no recall
EV_illness_norecall_0log_mean <- p_illness_norecall_0log_mean*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_norecall_4log_mean <- p_illness_norecall_4log_mean*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_norecall_5log_mean <- p_illness_norecall_5log_mean*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#EV no illness, no recall
EV_noillness_norecall_0log_mean <- (1- p_illness_norecall_0log_mean)*0
EV_noillness_norecall_4log_mean <- (1- p_illness_norecall_4log_mean)*0
EV_noillness_norecall_5log_mean <- (1- p_illness_norecall_5log_mean)*0


#Ev no recall
EV_norecall_0log_mean <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_0log_mean + EV_noillness_0log_mean
EV_norecall_4log_mean <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_4log_mean + EV_noillness_4log_mean
EV_norecall_5log_mean <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_5log_mean + EV_noillness_5log_mean


#creating contam detected vector for decision making
contam_detect_test_0log_mean <- c(median(EV_recall_noillness), median(EV_norecall_0log_mean)) #combine into vector so can compare, thsi is the EV of contam detected during test solutions

contam_detect_test_4log_mean <- c(median(EV_recall_noillness), median(EV_norecall_4log_mean)) #combine into vector so can compare, thsi is the EV of contam detected during test solutions

contam_detect_test_5log_mean <- c(median(EV_recall_noillness), median(EV_norecall_5log_mean)) #combine into vector so can compare, thsi is the EV of contam detected during test solutions


#ev contam detect test
EV_contam_detect_test_0log_mean <- p_test_contam_0log*(min(contam_detect_test_0log_mean)) #dollars
EV_contam_detect_test_4log_mean <- p_test_contam_4log*(min(contam_detect_test_4log_mean)) #dollars
EV_contam_detect_test_5log_mean <- p_test_contam_5log*(min(contam_detect_test_5log_mean)) #dollars


#convert to cash flows
#0 log
cashflow_0log_mean1 <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_0log_mean + EV_contam_detect_test_0log_mean #cost in dollars
#set up cash flow vector for desired analysis length
analysis_length <- 20 #years
cashflow_0log_mean <- rep(0, each = analysis_length)
cashflow_0log_mean[1] <- cashflow_0log_mean1

#Calculate annual cash flow - for loop
for (t in 2:length(cashflow_0log_mean)){
  #check if it's a year that has a training cost
  if (t %% 4 == 0){
    cost_training_tech <- 0 #dollars
  } else {
    cost_training_tech <- 0 #dollars
  }
  cashflow_0log_mean[t] <- cost_training_tech + cashflow_0log_mean1 #ADD ALL THE COSTS
}


#4 log
cashflow_4log_mean1 <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_4log_mean + EV_contam_detect_test_4log_mean #cost in dollars
#set up cash flow vector for desired analysis length
analysis_length <- 20 #years
cashflow_4log_mean <- rep(0, each = analysis_length)
cashflow_4log_mean[1] <-  cost_capital_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[4] +  cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[4]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_4log_mean1

#Calculate annual cash flow - for loop
for (t in 2:length(cashflow_4log_mean)){
  #check if it's a year that has a training cost
  if (t %% 4 == 0){
    cost_training_tech <- 20000 #dollars
  } else {
    cost_training_tech <- 0 #dollars
  }
  cashflow_4log_mean[t] <- cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[4]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_4log_mean1 #ADD ALL THE COSTS
}



#5 log
cashflow_5log_mean1 <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_5log_mean + EV_contam_detect_test_5log_mean #cost in dollars
#set up cash flow vector for desired analysis length
analysis_length <- 20 #years
cashflow_5log_mean <- rep(0, each = analysis_length)
cashflow_5log_mean[1] <- cost_capital_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[5] +  cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[5]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_5log_mean1

#Calculate annual cash flow - for loop
for (t in 2:length(cashflow_5log_mean)){
  #check if it's a year that has a training cost
  if (t %% 4 == 0){
    cost_training_tech <- 20000 #dollars
  } else {
    cost_training_tech <- 0 #dollars
  }
  cashflow_5log_mean[t] <- cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[5]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_5log_mean1 #ADD ALL THE COSTS
}
```

```{r}
#0 log
npv_0log_median <- function(cashflow_0log_median, d_rate) {
  npv_0log_median_calc <- sum(cashflow_0log_median / (1 + d_rate)^(0:(length(cashflow_0log_median)-1)))
  return(npv_0log_median_calc)
}

npv_result_0log_median <- npv_0log_median(cashflow_0log_median, d_rate)

  return(npv_4log_median_calc)
}

  return(npv_5log_median_calc)
}

npv_result_5log_median <- npv_5log_median(cashflow_5log_median, d_rate)
```

```{r}
#switchover point analysis, recall size

recall_size_kg_switchover <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = 100) #create range to represent % of production recalled

#sub switchover vector into calculations to determine effect

#cost lost product
recall_size_kg_switchover_amt <- recall_size_kg_switchover*sales_original
cost_lost_product_switchover_recall_size <- recall_size_kg_switchover_amt*price_original 

#cost restocking/holding product
amt_product_restock_switchover_recall_size <- recall_size_kg_switchover_amt*restock_factor

cost_restocking1_switchover_recall_size <- destroy_fee*amt_product_restock_switchover_recall_size + restocking_fee*number_stores  

cost_restocking_switchover_recall_size <- cost_restocking1_switchover_recall_size + spillover_rate*cost_restocking1_switchover_recall_size #accounts for spillover rate

cost_holding_product_switchover_recall_size <- holding_fee*(holding_rate*amt_product_restock_switchover_recall_size) #dollars, assumes a batch that is ~5-10% the size of the restocked amount is not recalled, but must be held somewhere.

cost_restocking_switchover_recall_size <- cost_restocking_switchover_recall_size + cost_holding_product_switchover_recall_size


#recall cost
recallcost_switchover_recall_size <- cost_lost_product_switchover_recall_size + cost_restocking_switchover_recall_size + cost_litigation + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product + cost_demandchange_otherproduct + cost_temp_lost_production + cost_recallins_premium  - benefits_recallins
recallcost_switchover_recall_size <- ifelse(recall_size_kg_switchover_amt == 0, 0, recallcost_switchover_recall_size)


#recall cost, no illness
recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_recall_size <- noillness_recall_factor*(cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product + cost_demandchange_otherproduct) + cost_recallins_premium + cost_lost_product_switchover_recall_size + cost_restocking_switchover_recall_size + cost_temp_lost_production  - benefits_recallins


recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_recall_size <- ifelse(recall_size_kg_switchover_amt == 0, 0, recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_recall_size)


#EV traceability
EV_traceability1_switchover_recall_size <- p_outbreaktraced_trace1*(recallcost_switchover_recall_size + cost_traceability1) + (1 - p_outbreaktraced_trace1)*cost_traceability1 # dollars, expected value of node where outbreak is traced to company or not


#EV illness linked to outbreak, all treatments

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_switchover_recall_size <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_0log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_recall_size) 

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_switchover_recall_size <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_4log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_recall_size) 

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_switchover_recall_size <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_5log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_recall_size) 


#EV illness: note that EV illness not linked to outbreak is not adjusted for switchover because it is p(illness not linke), which is 0, times $0
EV_illness_0log_median_switchover_recall_size <- (annualrisk_0log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_switchover_recall_size + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_4log_median_switchover_recall_size <- (annualrisk_4log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_switchover_recall_size + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_5log_median_switchover_recall_size <- (annualrisk_5log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_switchover_recall_size + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#EV contam not detected, with switchover vectors
EV_contam_notdetected_0log_median_switchover_recall_size <- (1 - p_test_contam_0log)*(EV_illness_0log_median_switchover_recall_size + EV_noillness_0log_median)

EV_contam_notdetected_4log_median_switchover_recall_size <- (1 - p_test_contam_4log)*(EV_illness_4log_median_switchover_recall_size + EV_noillness_4log_median)

EV_contam_notdetected_5log_median_switchover_recall_size <- (1 - p_test_contam_5log)*(EV_illness_5log_median_switchover_recall_size + EV_noillness_5log_median)


#EV recall no illness
EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_recall_size <- recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_recall_size #dollars

EV_recall_noillness_4log_median_switchover_recall_size <- recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_recall_size #dollars

EV_recall_noillness_5log_median_switchover_recall_size <- recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_recall_size #dollars


#EV illness no recall
EV_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_recall_size <- p_illness_norecall_0log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_switchover_recall_size + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_recall_size <- p_illness_norecall_4log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_switchover_recall_size + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_norecall_5log_median_switchover_recall_size <- p_illness_norecall_5log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_switchover_recall_size + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#EV no recall
EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_recall_size  <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_recall_size  + EV_noillness_0log_median

EV_norecall_4log_median_switchover_recall_size  <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_recall_size  + EV_noillness_4log_median

EV_norecall_5log_median_switchover_recall_size  <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_5log_median_switchover_recall_size  + EV_noillness_5log_median


#calculating contam_detect_test and EV_contam_detect test. decision tree must choose 'best decision' (least expensive) using switchover vector

##0 log
# Step 1: Calculate the difference A - B
difference_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_recall_size <- EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_recall_size - EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_recall_size

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences
negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_recall_size <- sum(difference_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_recall_size < 0) #when the difference is negative, no recall is the worse decision (higher EV)

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_recall_size > length(EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_recall_size) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
  EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_recall_size <- EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_recall_size*p_test_contam_0log
} else {
  # Otherwise, multiply vector B by p
 EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_recall_size  <- EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_recall_size*p_test_contam_0log
}


#4 log

# Step 1: Calculate the difference A - B
difference_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_recall_size <- EV_recall_noillness_4log_median_switchover_recall_size - EV_norecall_4log_median_switchover_recall_size

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences
negative_count_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_recall_size <- sum(difference_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_recall_size < 0) #when the difference is negative, no recall is the worse decision (higher EV)

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_recall_size > length(EV_recall_noillness_4log_median_switchover_recall_size) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
  EV_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_recall_size <- EV_recall_noillness_4log_median_switchover_recall_size*p_test_contam_4log
} else {
  # Otherwise, multiply vector B by p
 EV_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_recall_size  <- EV_norecall_4log_median_switchover_recall_size*p_test_contam_4log
}


## 5 log
# Step 1: Calculate the difference A - B
difference_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_recall_size <- EV_recall_noillness_5log_median_switchover_recall_size - EV_norecall_5log_median_switchover_recall_size

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences
negative_count_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_recall_size <- sum(difference_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_recall_size < 0) #when the difference is negative, no recall is the worse decision (higher EV)

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_recall_size > length(EV_recall_noillness_5log_median_switchover_recall_size) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
  EV_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_recall_size <- EV_recall_noillness_5log_median_switchover_recall_size*p_test_contam_5log
} else {
  # Otherwise, multiply vector B by p
 EV_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_recall_size  <- EV_norecall_5log_median_switchover_recall_size*p_test_contam_5log
}



#cash flows

#0 log
cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_recall_size <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_0log_median_switchover_recall_size + EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_recall_size #dollars


#initialize empty list to store cash flow vectors
result_list_0log_median_recall_size_switchover <- vector("list", length = length(recall_size_kg_switchover))


# Define the calculation function
calculate_cashflow_0log_median_switchover_recall_size <- function() {
  result <- numeric(20)  # Initialize an empty vector of length 20, result is the cash flow vector
  
  for (t in 1:20) {
    # Apply special calculation for the first item
    if (t == 1) {
      result[t] <- cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_recall_size[i] # Adjust formula for first item
    } else {
      result[t] <- cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_recall_size[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t]  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Loop through each value to calculate cashflow
for (i in 1:length(recall_size_kg_switchover)) {
  # The first item in each vector has its own calculation
  result_list_0log_median_recall_size_switchover[[i]] <- calculate_cashflow_0log_median_switchover_recall_size()
}



#4 log

#convert to cash flow
cashflow_4log_median1_switchover_recall_size <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_4log_median_switchover_recall_size + EV_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_recall_size #dollars
#set up cash flow vector for desired analysis length


#initialize empty list to store cash flow vectors
result_list_4log_median_recall_size_switchover <- vector("list", length = length(recall_size_kg_switchover))


# Define the calculation function
calculate_cashflow_4log_median_switchover_recall_size <- function() {
  result <- numeric(20)  # Initialize an empty vector of length 20, result is the cash flow vector
  
  for (t in 1:20) {
    # Apply special calculation for the first item
    if (t == 1) {
      result[t] <- cost_capital_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[4] + cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[4]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_4log_median1_switchover_recall_size[i] # Adjust formula for first item
    } else {
      result[t] <- extra_reduction_cost_factor[4]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_4log_median1_switchover_recall_size[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t] + cost_training_tech  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Loop through each value to calculate cashflow
for (i in 1:length(recall_size_kg_switchover)) {
  # The first item in each vector has its own calculation
  result_list_4log_median_recall_size_switchover[[i]] <- calculate_cashflow_4log_median_switchover_recall_size()
}




#5 log

#initialize empty list to store cash flow vectors

# Define the calculation function
calculate_cashflow_5log_median_switchover_recall_size <- function() {
  result <- numeric(20)  # Initialize an empty vector of length 20, result is the cash flow vector
  
  for (t in 1:20) {
    # Apply special calculation for the first item
    if (t == 1) {
      result[t] <- cost_capital_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[5] + cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[5]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_5log_median1_switchover_recall_size[i] # Adjust formula for first item
    } else {
      result[t] <- extra_reduction_cost_factor[5]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_5log_median1_switchover_recall_size[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t] + cost_training_tech  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

EV_illness_4log_mean_switchover_recall_size <- (number_years*annualrisk_4log_mean)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_switchover_recall_size + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

#ev contam not detected
EV_contam_notdetected_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size <- (1 - p_test_contam_0log)*(EV_illness_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size + EV_noillness_0log_mean)

EV_contam_notdetected_4log_mean_switchover_recall_size <- (1 - p_test_contam_4log)*(EV_illness_4log_mean_switchover_recall_size + EV_noillness_4log_mean)

EV_contam_notdetected_5log_mean_switchover_recall_size <- (1 - p_test_contam_5log)*(EV_illness_5log_mean_switchover_recall_size + EV_noillness_5log_mean)

EV_norecall_5log_mean_switchover_recall_size <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_5log_mean_switchover_recall_size + EV_noillness_5log_mean


##calculating contam_detect_test and EV_contam_detect test. decision tree must choose best decision (lowest cost) using switchover vector

##0 log
# Step 1: Calculate the difference A - B
difference_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size <- EV_recall_noillness_switchover_recall_size - EV_norecall_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences
negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size <- sum(difference_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size < 0) #when the difference is negative, no recall is the worse decision (higher EV)

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size > length(EV_recall_noillness_switchover_recall_size) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
  EV_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size <- EV_recall_noillness_switchover_recall_size*p_test_contam_0log
} else {
  # Otherwise, multiply vector B by p
 EV_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size  <- EV_norecall_0log_mean_switchover_recall_size*p_test_contam_0log
}
```

```{r}
#unit_value switchover

unit_value_switchover <- seq(from =  2/0.453592, to = 8/0.453592, length.out = 100) #convert to kg

price_original_switchover_unit_value <- unit_value_switchover

cost_lost_product_switchover_unit_value <- amt_product_recalled*price_original_switchover_unit_value #dollars
price_new_switchover_unit_value <- (1 - price_decrease)*price_original_switchover_unit_value

cost_demandchange_product_switchover_unit_value <- (sales_original*price_original_switchover_unit_value*(number_years - sale_decreased_period)) - (sales_after_recall*price_new_switchover_unit_value*sale_decreased_period) #dollars, loss of sales/value due to demand change.

cost_temp_lost_production_switchover_unit_value <- plantdowntime*production_rate_downtime*price_original_switchover_unit_value #time*(kg/time)*($/kg)*% = dollar

#recall cost
recallcost_switchover_unit_value <- cost_lost_product_switchover_unit_value + cost_restocking + cost_litigation + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product_switchover_unit_value + cost_demandchange_otherproduct + cost_temp_lost_production_switchover_unit_value + cost_recallins_premium  - benefits_recallins 

#recall cost, no illnesses
recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_unit_value <- noillness_recall_factor*(cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product_switchover_unit_value + cost_demandchange_otherproduct) + cost_recallins_premium + cost_lost_product_switchover_unit_value + cost_restocking +  cost_temp_lost_production_switchover_unit_value  - benefits_recallins #multiply affected variables by scale factor

#sum total cost - everything
totalcost1_switchover_unit_value <- cost_capital_tech + cost_operating_tech + cost_lost_product_switchover_unit_value + cost_restocking + cost_litigation + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product_switchover_unit_value + cost_demandchange_otherproduct + cost_temp_lost_production + cost_traceability1 + cost_recallins_premium - benefits_recallins

#no recall cost
cost_temp_lost_production_norecall_switchover_unit_value <- plantdowntime_norecall*production_rate_downtime_norecall*price_original_switchover_unit_value #time*(kg/time)*($/kg)*% = dollar

cost_norecall_otherint_switchover_unit_value <- cost_ept_norecall + cost_temp_lost_production_norecall_switchover_unit_value +cost_sani_norecall


#EV

EV_traceability1_switchover_unit_value <- p_outbreaktraced_trace1*(recallcost_switchover_unit_value + cost_traceability1) + (1 - p_outbreaktraced_trace1)*cost_traceability1 # dollars, expected value of node where outbreak is traced to company or not


EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_0log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_unit_value) #

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_4log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_unit_value) #

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_5log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_unit_value) #


#means
EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_mean_switchover_unit_value <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_0log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_unit_value) 

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_mean_switchover_unit_value <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_4log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_unit_value) 

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_mean_switchover_unit_value <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_5log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_unit_value) 


#EV illness
EV_illness_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- (annualrisk_0log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- (annualrisk_4log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- (annualrisk_5log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#EV contam not detected
EV_contam_notdetected_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- (1 - p_test_contam_0log)*(EV_illness_0log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_noillness_0log_median)

EV_contam_notdetected_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- (1 - p_test_contam_4log)*(EV_illness_4log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_noillness_4log_median)

EV_contam_notdetected_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- (1 - p_test_contam_5log)*(EV_illness_5log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_noillness_5log_median)


#EV recall no illness
EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_unit_value #dollars

EV_recall_noillness_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_unit_value #dollars

EV_recall_noillness_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_unit_value #dollars

#EV illness no recall
EV_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- p_illness_norecall_0log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- p_illness_norecall_4log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_norecall_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- p_illness_norecall_5log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#EV no recall
EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- cost_norecall_otherint_switchover_unit_value + EV_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_noillness_0log_median

EV_norecall_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- cost_norecall_otherint_switchover_unit_value + EV_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_noillness_4log_median

EV_norecall_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- cost_norecall_otherint_switchover_unit_value + EV_illness_norecall_5log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_noillness_5log_median


##contam detect test
##calculating contam_detect_test and EV_contam_detect test. decision model must choose best decision using switchover vector

##0 log
# Step 1: Calculate the difference A - B
difference_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_unit_value - EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_unit_value

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences
negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- sum(difference_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_unit_value < 0) #when the difference is negative, no recall is the worse decision (higher EV)

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_unit_value > length(EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_unit_value) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
  EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_unit_value*p_test_contam_0log
} else {
  # Otherwise, multiply vector B by p
 EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_unit_value  <- EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_unit_value*p_test_contam_0log
}


##4 log
# Step 1: Calculate the difference A - B
difference_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- EV_recall_noillness_4log_median_switchover_unit_value - EV_norecall_4log_median_switchover_unit_value

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences
negative_count_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- sum(difference_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_unit_value < 0) #when the difference is negative, no recall is the worse decision (higher EV)

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_unit_value > length(EV_recall_noillness_4log_median_switchover_unit_value) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
  EV_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- EV_recall_noillness_4log_median_switchover_unit_value*p_test_contam_4log
} else {
  # Otherwise, multiply vector B by p
 EV_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_unit_value  <- EV_norecall_4log_median_switchover_unit_value*p_test_contam_4log
}


##5 log
# Step 1: Calculate the difference A - B
difference_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- EV_recall_noillness_5log_median_switchover_unit_value - EV_norecall_5log_median_switchover_unit_value

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences
negative_count_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- sum(difference_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_unit_value < 0) #when the difference is negative, no recall is the worse decision (higher EV)

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_unit_value > length(EV_recall_noillness_5log_median_switchover_unit_value) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
  EV_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- EV_recall_noillness_5log_median_switchover_unit_value*p_test_contam_5log
} else {
  # Otherwise, multiply vector B by p
 EV_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_unit_value  <- EV_norecall_5log_median_switchover_unit_value*p_test_contam_5log
}


#cash flows

#0 log
cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_unit_value <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_0log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_unit_value #dollars


#initialize empty list to store cash flow vectors
result_list_0log_median_unit_value_switchover <- vector("list", length = length(unit_value_switchover))


# Define the calculation function
calculate_cashflow_0log_median_switchover_unit_value <- function() {
  result <- numeric(20)  # Initialize an empty vector of length 20, result is the cash flow vector
  
  for (t in 1:20) {
    # Apply special calculation for the first item
    if (t == 1) {
      result[t] <- cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_unit_value[i] # Adjust formula for first item
    } else {
      result[t] <- cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_unit_value[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t]  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Loop through each value to calculate cashflow
for (i in 1:length(unit_value_switchover)) {
  # The first item in each vector has its own calculation
  result_list_0log_median_unit_value_switchover[[i]] <- calculate_cashflow_0log_median_switchover_unit_value()
}


#4 log

#convert to cash flow
cashflow_4log_median1_switchover_unit_value <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_4log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_contam_detect_test_4log_median_switchover_unit_value #dollars
#set up cash flow vector for desired analysis length


#initialize empty list to store cash flow vectors
result_list_4log_median_unit_value_switchover <- vector("list", length = length(unit_value_switchover))


# Define the calculation function
calculate_cashflow_4log_median_switchover_unit_value <- function() {
  result <- numeric(20)  # Initialize an empty vector of length 20, result is the cash flow vector
  
  for (t in 1:20) {
    # Apply special calculation for the first item
    if (t == 1) {
      result[t] <- cost_capital_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[4] + cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[4]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_4log_median1_switchover_unit_value[i] # Adjust formula for first item
    } else {
      result[t] <- extra_reduction_cost_factor[4]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_4log_median1_switchover_unit_value[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t] + cost_training_tech  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Loop through each value to calculate cashflow
for (i in 1:length(unit_value_switchover)) {
  # The first item in each vector has its own calculation
  result_list_4log_median_unit_value_switchover[[i]] <- calculate_cashflow_4log_median_switchover_unit_value()
}



#5 log 

#convert to cash flow
cashflow_5log_median1_switchover_unit_value <- cost_recallins_premium + EV_contam_notdetected_5log_median_switchover_unit_value + EV_contam_detect_test_5log_median_switchover_unit_value #dollars, includes EVs (probabilities for recall costs)


#initialize empty list to store cash flow vectors
result_list_5log_median_unit_value_switchover <- vector("list", length = length(unit_value_switchover))


# Define the calculation function
calculate_cashflow_5log_median_switchover_unit_value <- function() {
  result <- numeric(20)  # Initialize an empty vector of length 20, result is the cash flow vector
  
  for (t in 1:20) {
    # Apply special calculation for the first item
    if (t == 1) {
      result[t] <- cost_capital_tech*extra_reduction_cost_factor[5] + cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[5]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_5log_median1_switchover_unit_value[i] # Adjust formula for first item
    } else {
      result[t] <- extra_reduction_cost_factor[5]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_5log_median1_switchover_unit_value[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t] + cost_training_tech  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Loop through each value to calculate cashflow
for (i in 1:length(unit_value_switchover)) {
  # The first item in each vector has its own calculation
  result_list_5log_median_unit_value_switchover[[i]] <- calculate_cashflow_5log_median_switchover_unit_value()
}


#REPEAT STEPS FOR MEANS
EV_illness_0log_mean_switchover_unit_value <- (number_years*annualrisk_0log_mean)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_mean_switchover_unit_value + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_4log_mean_switchover_unit_value <- (number_years*annualrisk_4log_mean)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_mean_switchover_unit_value + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_contam_notdetected_4log_mean_switchover_unit_value <- (1 - p_test_contam_4log)*(EV_illness_4log_mean_switchover_unit_value + EV_noillness_4log_mean)

EV_contam_notdetected_5log_mean_switchover_unit_value <- (1 - p_test_contam_5log)*(EV_illness_5log_mean_switchover_unit_value + EV_noillness_5log_mean)

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences
negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_unit_value <- sum(difference_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_unit_value < 0) #when the difference is negative, no recall is the worse decision (higher EV)

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_unit_value > length(EV_recall_noillness_0log_mean_switchover_unit_value) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
  EV_contam_detect_test_0log_mean_switchover_unit_value <- EV_recall_noillness_0log_mean_switchover_unit_value*p_test_contam_0log

}
```

```{r}
#switchover analysis for sales_original

sales_original_switchover <- seq(from = 0, to = 90718474, length.out = 100) #kg
sales_original_other_switchover <- sales_original_switchover # need to adjust both in order to appropriately gauge effect of firm size

recall_size_kg_switchover_sales_original <- recall_size_rate*sales_original_switchover

cost_lost_product_switchover_sales_original <- recall_size_kg_switchover_sales_original*price_original

amt_product_restock_switchover_sales_original <- recall_size_kg_switchover_sales_original*restock_factor

cost_restocking1_switchover_sales_original <- destroy_fee*amt_product_restock_switchover_sales_original + restocking_fee*number_stores  #dollars NOTE: may need buffer/spillover here

cost_restocking_switchover_sales_original <- cost_restocking1_switchover_sales_original + spillover_rate*cost_restocking1_switchover_sales_original #account for spillover by assuming that it is an additional 5-10% of restocking fees for actually recalled product

cost_holding_product_switchover_sales_original <- holding_fee*(holding_rate*amt_product_restock_switchover_sales_original) #dollars, assumes a batch that is ~5-10% the size of the restocked amount is not recalled, but must be held somewhere.

cost_restocking_switchover_sales_original <- cost_restocking_switchover_sales_original + cost_holding_product_switchover_sales_original #include holding costs with restocking

sales_after_recall_switchover_sales_original <- (1 - sale_decrease_after_recall)*sales_original_switchover 

cost_demandchange_product_switchover_sales_original <- sales_original_switchover*price_new*sale_decrease_after_recall*sale_decreased_period #dollars, loss of sales/value due to demand change.

sales_after_recall_other_switchover_sales_original <- (1 - sale_decrease_after_recall_other)*sales_original_other_switchover #kg/year

cost_demandchange_otherproduct_switchover_sales_original <- sales_original_other_switchover*price_new_other*sale_decrease_after_recall_other*sale_decreased_period_other #dollars

production_rate_downtime_switchover_sales_original <- sales_original_switchover #kg/year

cost_temp_lost_production_switchover_sales_original <- plantdowntime*production_rate_downtime_switchover_sales_original*price_original #time*(kg/time)*($/kg)*% = dollar

recallcost_switchover_sales_original <- cost_lost_product_switchover_sales_original + cost_restocking_switchover_sales_original + cost_litigation + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product_switchover_sales_original + cost_demandchange_otherproduct_switchover_sales_original + cost_temp_lost_production_switchover_sales_original + cost_recallins_premium  - benefits_recallins


recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_sales_original <- noillness_recall_factor*( cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product_switchover_sales_original + cost_demandchange_otherproduct_switchover_sales_original) + cost_recallins_premium + cost_lost_product_switchover_sales_original + cost_restocking_switchover_sales_original +  cost_temp_lost_production_switchover_sales_original  - benefits_recallins #multiply applicable variables by scale factor


#sum total cost - everything
totalcost1_switchover_sales_original <- cost_capital_tech + cost_operating_tech + cost_lost_product_switchover_sales_original + cost_restocking_switchover_sales_original + cost_litigation + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product_switchover_sales_original + cost_demandchange_otherproduct_switchover_sales_original + cost_temp_lost_production_switchover_sales_original + cost_traceability1 + cost_recallins_premium - benefits_recallins

production_rate_downtime_norecall_switchover_sales_original <-  sales_original_switchover #kg otherwise produced during duration of downtown

cost_temp_lost_production_norecall_switchover_unit_value <- plantdowntime_norecall*production_rate_downtime_norecall_switchover_sales_original*price_original #time*(kg/time)*($/kg)*% = dollar


#calculate EV outbreak traced to company
EV_traceability1_switchover_sales_original <- p_outbreaktraced_trace1*(recallcost_switchover_sales_original + cost_traceability1) + (1 - p_outbreaktraced_trace1)*cost_traceability1 # dollars, expected value of node where outbreak is traced to company or not


#EV illness linked outbreak
EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_0log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_sales_original) #

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_4log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_sales_original) #

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_5log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_sales_original) #


#repeat for means
#EV illness linked

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_mean_switchover_sales_original <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_0log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_sales_original) 

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_mean_switchover_sales_original <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_4log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_sales_original) 

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_mean_switchover_sales_original <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_5log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_sales_original) 

#converting sales original
annualrisk_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_0_log)^(sales_original_switchover*servings_per_kg_core_product)

annualrisk_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- ifelse(annualrisk_0log_median_switchover_sales_original > 1, 1, annualrisk_0log_median_switchover_sales_original)

annualrisk_0log_median_switchover_sales_original_sanitize <- 10^(log10(annualrisk_0log_median_switchover_sales_original) -1) #annual risk if no recall, but other intervention (sanitization), assumed 1 log reduction in annual risk

#compound annual risk for 4 log

annualrisk_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_4_log)^(sales_original_switchover*servings_per_kg_core_product)

annualrisk_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- ifelse(annualrisk_4log_median_switchover_sales_original > 1, 1, annualrisk_4log_median_switchover_sales_original)

annualrisk_4log_median_switchover_sales_original_sanitize <- 10^(log10(annualrisk_4log_median_switchover_sales_original) -1) #annual risk if no recall, but other intervention (sanitization), assumed 1 log reduction in annual risk

#compound annual risk for 5 log - use same approach for the 3 different types of almonds

annualrisk_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_5_log)^(sales_original_switchover*servings_per_kg_core_product)

annualrisk_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- ifelse(annualrisk_5log_median_switchover_sales_original > 1, 1, annualrisk_5log_median_switchover_sales_original)

annualrisk_5log_median_switchover_sales_original_sanitize <- 10^(log10(annualrisk_5log_median_switchover_sales_original) -1) #annual risk if no recall, but other intervention (sanitization), assumed 1 log reduction in annual risk

#REPEAT ANNUAL RISK CALCULATIONS FOR MEAN
annualrisk_0log_mean_switchover_sales_original <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_0_log_mean)^(sales_original_switchover*servings_per_kg_core_product)

#0log
annualrisk_0log_mean_switchover_sales_original <- ifelse(annualrisk_0log_mean_switchover_sales_original > 1, 1, annualrisk_0log_mean_switchover_sales_original)

annualrisk_0log_mean_switchover_sales_original_sanitize <- 10^(log10(annualrisk_0log_mean_switchover_sales_original) -1) #annual risk if no recall, but other intervention (sanitization), assumed 1 log reduction in annual risk

#compound annual risk for 4 log

annualrisk_4log_mean_switchover_sales_original <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_4_log_mean)^(sales_original_switchover*servings_per_kg_core_product)

annualrisk_4log_mean_switchover_sales_original <- ifelse(annualrisk_4log_mean_switchover_sales_original > 1, 1, annualrisk_4log_mean_switchover_sales_original)

annualrisk_4log_mean_switchover_sales_original_sanitize <- 10^(log10(annualrisk_4log_mean_switchover_sales_original) -1) #annual risk if no recall, but other intervention (sanitization), assumed 1 log reduction in annual risk

#compound annual risk for 5 log - use same approach for the 3 different types of almonds

annualrisk_5log_mean_switchover_sales_original <- 1 - (1 - risk_per_serve_core_product_uncooked_5_log_mean)^(sales_original_switchover*servings_per_kg_core_product)

annualrisk_5log_mean_switchover_sales_original <- ifelse(annualrisk_5log_mean_switchover_sales_original > 1, 1, annualrisk_5log_mean_switchover_sales_original)

annualrisk_5log_mean_switchover_sales_original_sanitize <- 10^(log10(annualrisk_5log_mean_switchover_sales_original) -1) #annual risk if no recall, but other intervention (sanitization), assumed 1 log reduction in annual risk

#EV illness

EV_illness_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- (annualrisk_0log_median_switchover_sales_original)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- (annualrisk_4log_median_switchover_sales_original)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- (annualrisk_5log_median_switchover_sales_original)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#EV no illness
EV_noillness_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- (1 - (annualrisk_0log_median_switchover_sales_original))*0 #no costs for no illnesses

EV_noillness_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- (1 - (annualrisk_4log_median_switchover_sales_original))*0 #no costs for no illnesses

EV_noillness_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- (1 - (annualrisk_5log_median_switchover_sales_original))*0 #no costs for no illnesses


#EV contam not detected
EV_contam_notdetected_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- (1 - p_test_contam_0log)*(EV_illness_0log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_noillness_0log_median_switchover_sales_original)

EV_contam_notdetected_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- (1 - p_test_contam_4log)*(EV_illness_4log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_noillness_4log_median_switchover_sales_original)

EV_contam_notdetected_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- (1 - p_test_contam_5log)*(EV_illness_5log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_noillness_5log_median_switchover_sales_original)


#EV recall no illness
EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_sales_original #dollars

EV_recall_noillness_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_sales_original #dollars

EV_recall_noillness_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- recallcost_noillnesses_switchover_sales_original #dollars


#p illness no recall
p_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- number_years*annualrisk_0log_median_switchover_sales_original_sanitize 

p_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- number_years*annualrisk_4log_median_switchover_sales_original_sanitize 

p_illness_norecall_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- number_years*annualrisk_5log_median_switchover_sales_original_sanitize 


#ev illness, no recall

EV_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- p_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_sales_original*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- p_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_sales_original*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_norecall_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- p_illness_norecall_5log_median_switchover_sales_original*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#ev no recall

EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_noillness_0log_median_switchover_sales_original

EV_norecall_4log_median_switchover_sales_original <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_noillness_4log_median_switchover_sales_original

EV_norecall_5log_median_switchover_sales_original <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_5log_median_switchover_sales_original + EV_noillness_5log_median_switchover_sales_original


#calculating contam_detect_test and EV_contam_detect test. model must choose best decision using switchover vector

##0 log
# Step 1: Calculate the difference A - B
difference_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_sales_original - EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_sales_original

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences
negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_sales_original <- sum(difference_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_sales_original < 0) #when the difference is negative, no recall is the worse decision (higher EV)

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_sales_original > length(EV_recall_noillness_0log_median_switchover_sales_original) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
```

```{r}
##switchover, cost of capital tech
cost_capital_tech_switchover <- seq(from = 0, to = 25000000, length.out = 100)

#sum total cost - everything
totalcost1_switchover_capital_tech <- cost_capital_tech_switchover + cost_operating_tech + cost_lost_product + cost_restocking + cost_litigation + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product + cost_demandchange_otherproduct + cost_temp_lost_production + cost_traceability1 + cost_recallins_premium - benefits_recallins


#cost of tech only
foodsafetytech_cost_switchover_capital_tech <- cost_capital_tech_switchover + cost_operating_tech



#cash flows, medians

#0 log
#don't need to recalculate cashflow median1


#initialize empty list to store cash flow vectors
result_list_0log_median_capital_tech_switchover <- vector("list", length = length(cost_capital_tech_switchover))

cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_capital_tech <- rep(cashflow_0log_median1, 100)

# Define the calculation function
calculate_cashflow_0log_median_switchover_capital_tech <- function() {
  result <- numeric(20)  # Initialize an empty vector of length 20, result is the cash flow vector
  
  for (t in 1:20) {
    # Apply special calculation for the first item
    if (t == 1) {
      result[t] <- cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_capital_tech[i] # Adjust formula for first item, no capital tech for 0 log reduction technology
    } else {
      result[t] <- cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_capital_tech[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t]  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Loop through each value to calculate cashflow
for (i in 1:length(cost_capital_tech_switchover)) {
  # The first item in each vector has its own calculation
  result_list_0log_median_capital_tech_switchover[[i]] <- calculate_cashflow_0log_median_switchover_capital_tech()
}

      result[t] <- extra_reduction_cost_factor[4]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_4log_mean1_switchover_capital_tech[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t] + cost_training_tech  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Loop through each value to calculate cashflow
for (i in 1:length(cost_capital_tech_switchover)) {
  # The first item in each vector has its own calculation
  result_list_4log_mean_capital_tech_switchover[[i]] <- calculate_cashflow_4log_mean_switchover_capital_tech()
}


#5 log

#initialize empty list to store cash flow vectors

# Define the calculation function
calculate_cashflow_5log_mean_switchover_capital_tech <- function() {
  result <- numeric(20)  # Initialize an empty vector of length 20, result is the cash flow vector
  
  for (t in 1:20) {
    # Apply special calculation for the first item
    if (t == 1) {
      result[t] <- cost_capital_tech_switchover[i]*extra_reduction_cost_factor[5] + cost_training_tech + extra_reduction_cost_factor[5]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_5log_mean1_switchover_capital_tech[i] # Adjust formula for first item
    } else {
      result[t] <- extra_reduction_cost_factor[5]*cost_operating_tech + cashflow_5log_mean1_switchover_capital_tech[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t] + cost_training_tech  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Loop through each value to calculate cashflow
for (i in 1:length(cost_capital_tech_switchover)) {
  # The first item in each vector has its own calculation
  result_list_5log_mean_capital_tech_switchover[[i]] <- calculate_cashflow_5log_mean_switchover_capital_tech()
```
