##switchover, litigation cost
cost_litigation_switchover <- seq(from = 0, to = 200000000, length.out = 100)

#sum total cost - everything
totalcost1_switchover_litigation <- cost_capital_tech + cost_operating_tech + cost_lost_product + cost_restocking + cost_litigation_switchover + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product + cost_demandchange_otherproduct + cost_temp_lost_production + cost_traceability1 + cost_recallins_premium - benefits_recallins

#recall cost
recallcost_switchover_litigation <- cost_lost_product + cost_restocking + cost_litigation_switchover + cost_crisis_management + cost_ept + cost_demandchange_product + cost_demandchange_otherproduct + cost_temp_lost_production + cost_recallins_premium  - benefits_recallins 

#EV traceability
EV_traceability1_switchover_litigation <- p_outbreaktraced_trace1*(recallcost_switchover_litigation + cost_traceability1) + (1 - p_outbreaktraced_trace1)*cost_traceability1 # dollars, expected value of node where outbreak is traced to company or not


#EV illnes linked to outbreak
EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_switchover_litigation <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_0log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_litigation) #does not depend on mean/median risk yet

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_switchover_litigation <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_4log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_litigation) 

EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_switchover_litigation <- p_illness_linked_to_outbreak_5log*(EV_traceability1_switchover_litigation) 

#EV illness
EV_illness_0log_median_switchover_litigation <- (annualrisk_0log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_4log_median_switchover_litigation <- (annualrisk_4log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_5log_median_switchover_litigation <- (annualrisk_5log_median)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)


#EV illness mean
EV_illness_0log_mean_switchover_litigation <- (annualrisk_0log_mean)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_4log_mean_switchover_litigation <- (annualrisk_4log_mean)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_5log_mean_switchover_litigation <- (annualrisk_5log_mean)*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)

#EV contam not detected
EV_contam_notdetected_0log_median_switchover_litigation <- (1 - p_test_contam_0log)*(EV_illness_0log_median_switchover_litigation + EV_noillness_0log_median)

EV_contam_notdetected_4log_median_switchover_litigation <- (1 - p_test_contam_4log)*(EV_illness_4log_median_switchover_litigation + EV_noillness_4log_median)

EV_contam_notdetected_5log_median_switchover_litigation <- (1 - p_test_contam_5log)*(EV_illness_5log_median_switchover_litigation + EV_noillness_5log_median)

#EV cobntam not detected mean
EV_contam_notdetected_0log_mean_switchover_litigation <- (1 - p_test_contam_0log)*(EV_illness_0log_mean_switchover_litigation + EV_noillness_0log_mean)

EV_contam_notdetected_4log_mean_switchover_litigation <- (1 - p_test_contam_4log)*(EV_illness_4log_mean_switchover_litigation + EV_noillness_4log_mean)

EV_contam_notdetected_5log_mean_switchover_litigation <- (1 - p_test_contam_5log)*(EV_illness_5log_mean_switchover_litigation + EV_noillness_5log_mean)

#EV illness no recall
EV_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_litigation <- p_illness_norecall_0log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_0log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_0log)

EV_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_litigation <- p_illness_norecall_4log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_norecall_5log_median_switchover_litigation <- p_illness_norecall_5log_median*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)

#EV illness no recall mean

EV_illness_norecall_4log_mean_switchover_litigation <- p_illness_norecall_4log_mean*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_4log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_4log)

EV_illness_norecall_5log_mean_switchover_litigation <- p_illness_norecall_5log_mean*(EV_illnesslinked_outbreak_5log_switchover_litigation + EV_illnessnotlinked_outbreak_5log)

#EV no recall

EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_litigation <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_0log_median_switchover_litigation + EV_noillness_0log_median

EV_norecall_4log_median_switchover_litigation <- cost_norecall_otherint + EV_illness_norecall_4log_median_switchover_litigation + EV_noillness_4log_median

# Step 2: Count the number of negative differences

# Step 3: Check if the difference is negative more than 50% of the time (i.e., 50 out of 100 times)
if (negative_count_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_litigation > length(EV_recall_noillness) / 2) {
  # If difference is negative more than 50% of the time, multiply vector A by p
  EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_litigation <- EV_recall_noillness*p_test_contam_0log

  # Otherwise, multiply vector B by p
 EV_contam_detect_test_0log_median_switchover_litigation <- EV_norecall_0log_median_switchover_litigation*p_test_contam_0log

      result[t] <- cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_litigation[i] # Adjust formula for first item, no capital tech for 0 log reduction technology
    } else {
      result[t] <- cashflow_0log_median1_switchover_litigation[i]
    }
    
    # Add additional cost for staff training every 4th iteration
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      result[t] <- result[t]  # Add staff training cost every 4th year, cost training tech already defined
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# NPV calculation function
npv_0log_median_switchover_litigation <- function(vector_20, d_rate) {
  npv_0log_median_calc_switchover_litigation <- sum(vector_20 / (1 + d_rate)^(0:(length(vector_20)-1)))
  return(npv_0log_median_calc_switchover_litigation)
}

  npv_results_0log_median_switchover_litigation[i] <- npv_0log_median_switchover_litigation(result_list_0log_median_litigation_switchover[[i]], d_rate)
}

# Function to calculate NPV. Note that NPV is the total COST (high number = worse)
npv_5log_median_switchover_litigation <- function(vector_20, d_rate) {
  npv_5log_median_calc_switchover_litigation <- sum(vector_20 / (1 + d_rate)^(0:(length(vector_20)-1)))
  return(npv_5log_median_calc_switchover_litigation)
}

# Define a vector to store NPVs for each of the 100 vectors
npv_results_5log_median_switchover_litigation <- numeric(length(result_list_5log_median_litigation_switchover))

# Loop through each 20-long vector in the result list to calculate the NPV for each
for (i in 1:length(result_list_5log_median_litigation_switchover)) {
  npv_results_5log_median_switchover_litigation[i] <- npv_5log_median_switchover_litigation(result_list_5log_median_litigation_switchover[[i]], d_rate)
}
